'''Imperial shocktroopers''' were [[Imperial soldier|soldiers]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They were deployed during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic]] in several battlefields, including at the [[Battle of Corellia]].
